title: The Ruler's Daughter
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever had to trust through a delay — when every second felt like it mattered and nothing was moving fast enough?
reflectionText: Jairus was a man with authority — but when his daughter was dying, none of that mattered. He fell in the dust at a stranger's feet and begged. Then came the delay, then the worst news: too late. What is it to keep walking with the one who did not rush, who stopped for the woman in the crowd, and who said only: do not be afraid, only believe?
